AppFlowy Editor 6.2.0
https://pub.dev/packages/appflowy_editor/versions/6.2.0
https://github.com/AppFlowy-IO/appflowy-editor

The published LICENSE offers AGPL-3.0 and Mozilla Public License 2.0 options.
ADELE uses the MPL-2.0 option for AppFlowy Editor and its local modifications.
The patch fragments and modified covered files remain available under MPL-2.0:
https://www.mozilla.org/MPL/2.0/

Source is the published archive pinned in preparation.json. The adjacent patches
contain ADELE's complete modifications. 01-remove-unused-device-info.patch removes
the unused Android SDK probe and device_info_plus dependency, without replacing
keyboard handling. 02-compatible-file-picker.patch pins file_picker to exactly
12.0.0-beta.3 and adapts three calls to its static API, retaining file selection,
bytes/path results, and path-only desktop save behavior.

That exact published prerelease accepts win32 ^6.2.0 and the pinned Dart 3.10.9 /
Flutter 3.38.10 toolchain. Stable file_picker 10.x/11.x require Win32 5; stable
12.x changes saveFile to require bytes and return a URI, so it is not substituted.
The functional dependency is retained, not stubbed or force-overridden. Its
published MIT license (Copyright (c) 2018 Miguel Ruivo) remains part of normal
dependency notice collection; no file_picker source is vendored here.

03-compatible-image.patch adds an exact image 4.10.2 dependency constraint for
the PDF dependency graph. It satisfies pdf 3.12.0's declared image range and
uses archive 4.0.9's decodeBytes API. image 4.11.0 calls decodeLazy, unavailable
under pdf 3.12.0's archive <4.1 constraint; pdf 3.13.1 requires Dart >=3.12.
This is a normal intersecting constraint, not a dependency override
or codec modification. AppFlowy has no direct image imports to adapt. Keep
image's published MIT notice (Copyright (c) 2013-2022 Brendan Duncan) in normal
dependency notice collection; no image or PDF source is vendored here.

tools/rich_editor_dependency.dart applies the ordered patches reproducibly.
Provide recipients the covered source and these patches when distributing a
build, with instructions for obtaining the modified source.

Preparation preserves the original LICENSE verbatim, including both offered
licenses. It also preserves the embedded BSD-style source notices:
Copyright 2014 The Flutter Authors. All rights reserved.
Copyright 2019 The Fuchsia Authors. All rights reserved.
These appear in lib/src/flutter/overlay.dart, scrollable_helpers.dart, and
scrollable_positioned_list/. They are not replaced by the MPL election.

Preserve Flutter's generated dependency notices as well. This is source
attribution and modification availability guidance, not a complete notice
inventory or release redistribution clearance. Review the actual shipped
contents, transitive dependencies, and embedded BSD license requirements before
distribution.
